verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI (npm i -g @stripe/cli) that it explicitly frames as "agent-ready tooling". Coding agents are told to use it to provision anonymous sandboxes, and `stripe agent setup` auto-configures Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Agent-oriented extensions round this out: Projects provisioning, `stripe directory search --format json`, and the Link CLI's `--llms-full` and `--schema` for machine-readable command contracts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working in agent workflows (all evidence is first-party docs plus a probe confirming the docs page exists).
